C1600.title: Mirai Botnet Leverages IoT Devices for DDoS Attacks
C1600.summary: In 2016, the Mirai attack used compromised IoT devices to build a botnet, launching distributed denial-of-service attacks against DNS infrastructure via C2 servers, causing widespread internet outages across Europe and North America with estimated economic losses of $110 million.
